lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and holders of 5% or more of its shares agree not to sell shares for 180 days after the offering closes. Customary exceptions apply.

what: It is a Montana gold and silver explorer working to develop its Basin Gulch Project, with no revenue yet.
proceeds: It plans to pay for more drilling and testing at the Basin Gulch site and to prepare a first resource report. It will also cover its working capital shortfall, overhead and general business costs.
risks: All of its work is at the exploration stage, and it may never find gold or silver that can be mined for profit.
It works in only one area, so any problem with that site or its permits hurts the whole business.
Gold and silver prices swing widely, so any minerals it finds may not sell at a profit.
It may spend money on exploration and find nothing worth mining, or find deposits too small to make a profit.
risks_note: The first 4 risk factors, summarised by AI.
